values.note: Each site has individual water and electric hookups; the park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/paris-mountain/camping ('Each site has individual water and electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 39 paved water/electric sites, 13 of them designated tent sites with tent pads. 'Some sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 35 feet.' Five trailside backpacking sites on the North Lake Trail loop are reserved only through the park. Campers must keep a vehicle on site for the whole stay.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/paris-mountain/camping ('39 sites are paved, 13 of which offer tent pads'; 'Some sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 35 feet'; 'five trailside sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/paris-mountain/camping ('The campground is convenient to restroom facilities with hot showers'; 'Dump Station: Yes'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-244-5565). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/paris-mountain/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/paris-mountain/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m., check-out 12:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water hookups (amperage not stated), 39 paved W/E sites (13 designated tent sites) taking RVs to 35-40 ft, showers, dump, 14-night max. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note kept. Not stated: amps, sewer, campground season, pull-throughs, laundry.
